sections.heading: How To Use?
sections.text:
*BOTOX CREAM* (Use In The Morning)

1. Cleanse Your Skin First.

2. Take a sufficient amount of Botox cream on the palm of your hands.

3. Gently Massage it on your face until it gets fully absorbed.
____________________________________________________________________

*GLUTATHIONE 3D SERUM* (Use At Night)

1. Cleanse the face thoroughly. 
2. Apply a coin-sized amount of Glutathione Serum all over your face and neck. 
3. Use short but firm strokes to apply the serum. Do not stretch, pull or rub the skin.

 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Unlock Time Reversal Combo: Ageless Glow, Round the Clock! ⏳✨India’s First Age-Reversal Routine with Rupture Technology — Trusted by 3+ Million Users

Step into the future of skincare with a breakthrough innovation — Rupture Technology, featuring micro 3D capsules that burst fresh, potent actives directly onto your skin for maximum absorption and visible transformation. This is the first time such technology is being introduced in the skincare industry.

The Time Reversal Combo brings together two powerful routines designed to work in perfect synergy:

🌤 Morning — Botox Day CreamFirms, lifts, and smoothens the skin for an instantly refreshed, tightened look.

🌙 Night — Glutathione 3D Glow Skin SerumBrightens, repairs, and boosts radiance overnight with antioxidant-rich actives.

Powered by Centella Reversa, Glutathione, Vitamin E, and rupture beads, this duo delivers deep repair, powerful protection, and age-defying results around the clock. With consistent use, skin appears firmer, clearer, smoother, more even-toned, and naturally youthful.

✨ Achievements
 • 4+ years of formulation research
 • 3.5+ million units sold
 • Trusted by 2+ million customers
 • India’s First Age-Reversal Routine with Rupture Technology
 • Proven visible results with consistent use
 • Top Choice for Repeat Shoppers in India

The Time Reversal Combo isn’t just skincare — it’s youthfulness reinvented, restoring your skin’s confidence, vitality, and timeless glow.

 Ingredients
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Botox Cream (Day Routine)

*Centella Reversa

A powerful skin-restoring botanical known for its ability to boost collagen, improve elasticity, and support skin barrier repair. It helps smooth the look of fine lines and provides a naturally lifted, firm, youthful texture to the skin throughout the day.

*Vitamin E

Deeply nourishes and protects the skin from environmental stress, keeping it soft, moisturized, and healthy.

____________________________________________________________________________________________________

Glutathione 3D Serum (Night Routine)

*Glutathione

A master antioxidant that helps brighten dull skin, reduce uneven pigmentation, and restore natural clarity.

*Vitamin E

Deeply nourishes and protects the skin from environmental stress, keeping it soft, moisturized, and healthy.

 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1: What is the Time Reversal Combo?

A: The Time Reversal Combo is a curated set of skincare products designed to target signs of aging and promote youthful, radiant skin.

Q2: How do I use the Time Reversal Combo in my skincare routine?

A2: Follow the recommended usage instructions provided with each product in the combo for better results.

Q3: How long should I wait to see improvements in fine lines and wrinkles?

A3: Results may vary, but noticeable improvements can often be seen after a few weeks of consistent use.
